agent_report.reasoning:
batch 1: The native crops support the proposed visible markers in the contested boxes, including the black square at panel pixel (360.6,275.3), but the template-filled CO2 283K claim at (253.0,566.0) has no red hexagonal marker in the untouched source; the visible structures there belong to other overlapping series. The crowded-strip slot claims for CO2 313K, CO2 323K, and CO2 373K do not show a sufficiently identifiable native glyph core, so I made no additions from those slots. The batch therefore remains incomplete and requires another native-resolution pass for the unresolved low-pressure series.
batch 2: I inspected every attached native tile and each separately listed native box. The contested CO2 303K, 323K, 333K, 343K, and 353K claims have source-pixel support; the two template-fit claims (CO2 323K at panel pixel approximately (482,387) and CO2 353K at approximately (351,564)) also coincide with visible native glyphs and should be retained. The crowded native crops do not provide sufficiently separable evidence for additional omitted markers, ownership changes, or defensible centre corrections, so no mechanical operations are issued. The global Python shortfalls for CO2 313K and CO2 323K remain unresolved rather than being filled from expected counts or curve appearance.
batch 3: Inspected all attached native tiles and the three native complex-region crops. The template-fill CO2 373K claims at panel pixels (238.44,732.28) and (261.29,711.21) have no source-visible circle markers and are deleted. The template-fit claims in the crowded 353K and 363K strips coincide with identifiable colored marker glyphs or fragments in the native crops; they are retained with source-supported centers and uncertainty. The native evidence does not safely resolve all omitted low-pressure 313K and 323K markers, so those series remain incomplete rather than being filled from expected counts.
batch 4: The native ambiguity crops show source-supported magenta left-triangle and olive right-triangle CO2 marker glyphs in the crowded low-pressure region that were not represented by Python point rows. I added one supported marker of each series in each of ambiguity crops 001-007, using broad uncertainties because the glyphs are overlapped. Crops 008-011 confirm the black CO2 273K square sequence without a supported positional correction. Crops 012-014 show black N2 313K triangles in the low band rather than omitted CO2 markers, so no CO2 additions are made there. The CO2 313K and 323K series remain incomplete because this batch does not expose enough unambiguous native marker centers to recover all of the reported shortfall.
batch 5: I inspected all 15 attached native ambiguity crops. The template-filled CO2 283K claim at panel pixel approximately (253,566) has no source-visible red hexagon; the native crop instead shows overlapping markers from other series, so that unsupported point is deleted. The high-pressure red/blue and low-pressure red/teal overlaps were retained where the native pixels support existing markers or do not safely resolve ownership. The black CO2 273K versus N2 313K crops contain fused black glyphs and lines that do not permit a safe series-specific addition. No omitted CO2 marker can be added from these crops without relying on expected counts or interpolation. The source legend also confirms CO2 363K uses a star, but legend metadata is outside the point-edit operation schema and no point operation is warranted here.
batch 6: The native ambiguity crops were inspected individually. The crowded red/teal/purple regions in ambiguity_030 through ambiguity_042 and ambiguity_044 do not safely resolve additional CO2 ownership or demonstrate a false candidate, so no edits are applied there. In ambiguity_043, the proposed CO2 373K point at panel pixel (261.29, 711.21) has no supporting dark-blue filled circular glyph in the native crop; the visible pixels belong to other overlapping low-loading series, so the template-filled proposal is deleted. The supplied batch does not establish completeness for the severely undersampled CO2 313K and CO2 323K series or for the absent CO2 363K candidate inventory.
batch 7: I inspected all 15 attached native ambiguity crops. Crops ambiguity_045 through ambiguity_051 and ambiguity_053 through ambiguity_059 show only excluded N2 293K/N2 353K crowded markers, so they provide no source-supported CO2 edit. ambiguity_052 contains one resolvable filled CO2 293K up-triangle centered near full-panel pixel (510,297), with no separate marker at the nearby claimed centers around (502,298) and (516,297). I therefore removed those two duplicate/unsupported CO2 claims and retained pt-952a4f639b23fafd. The broader low-pressure shortfalls for CO2 313K and CO2 323K remain unresolved because no native evidence in this batch safely establishes additional markers.
batch 8: Inspected all 15 attached native ambiguity crops. The disputed CO2 293K triangle-up clusters are source-visible and retained; the crowded CO2 303K/CO2 283K region contains visible non-template markers, but the CO2 283K template_fill claim at panel (253.0,566.0) has no source-supported red hexagon. The CO2 373K template_fill claim at (261.29,711.21) likewise has no identifiable blue filled circle in the native crop and is deleted. No additional CO2 marker can be safely added from these crops alone, and the broader 313K/323K shortfalls remain unresolved because expected counts and curve continuity are not evidence.
batch 9: Inspected all six ambiguity crops and both proposed-slot native crops. The teal downward triangles in ambiguity_075, ambiguity_077, and ambiguity_080 are source-visible CO2 303K markers omitted from the proposal; overlapping crops confirm these are distinct marker locations rather than interpolation. The native slot crop for slot:0001 contains one olive right-triangle marker whose centre is substantially left of the proposed CO2 323K point, so that point is moved. The native slot crop for slot:0002 contains a magenta left-triangle marker near (581,339) in addition to the existing magenta marker near (599,337), so one CO2 313K point is added. Other crowded candidates were retained because native pixels support their existence or do not safely resolve ownership. The supplied batch does not establish completeness for all low-confidence regions, so the result remains under review.
